NAJLAŽJE IN NAJPREGLEDNEJŠE POLNJENJE VAŠEGA ELEKTRIČNEGA VOZILA
Aplikacija ima vgrajen interaktiven zemljevid polnilnih postaj, ki vam na vsakem koraku nudi informacije o najbližji električni polnilni postaji in natančne podatke o številu priključkov in priključni moči, zasedenosti posameznega priključka in ceni polnjenja. Z aplikacijo lahko na vsaki polnilnici aktivirate polnjenje svojega električnega vozila, račun za polnjenje pa prejmete na vaši mesečni položnici za GEN-I elektriko ali plin. ENOSTAVNA UPORABA KJERKOLI IN KADARKOLI.
Začnite z uporabo aplikacije že danes:
1. Preverite, če imate ustvarjen uporabniški račun na portalu Moj GEN-I. Če ne, ga ustvarite.

Moj GEN-I Charge enables GEN-I customers carefree travel with an electric vehicle in Slovenia and abroad. Application allows you to charge your electric vehicle at more than 200,000 public electric charging stations in as many as 28 countries.

EASY AND TRANSPARENT WAY OF CHARGING YOUR ELECTRIC VEHICLE
The application has a built-in interactive map of charging stations, which at every step provides information about the nearest electric charging station with detailed information on the number of connections and energy power, occupancy of each connection and charging fee. Using the application  you can activate the charging of your electric vehicle at each charging station. The charging fee will be included on the your monthly invoice for natural gas or electricity. You can control the cost of electricity consumption by yourself.

EASY TO USE. ANYWHERE AND ANYTIME.
Start using the app today:
1. Check if you have a user account on the Moj GEN-I portal. If you don’t have it, create it.
2. Download the app from the App Store.
3. Log in to the application with the same username and password as you use for the Moj GEN-I portal.

WHAT ARE THE BENEFITS OF THE Moj GEN-I Charge APPLICATION?
1. Monitor the monthly electricity consumption when charging electric vehicle.
2. Check the location of the nearest free e-charger, the number of connections and the energy power.
3. Check the price of charging your electric vehicle at each e-charging station.
